title: Astralis
description: A mod adding armor, weapons and some other stuff
body:
A mod i made for fun using Mcreator

# CURIOS API IS A REQUIRED DEPENDENCY

This mod adds:

- Cosmic metal tools and armor
- Blazing tools and armor 
- A meteorite structure
- Augments and artefacts (curios baubles)
- Alot of building blocks
And many other things
